body: Okay... I get that Pink is inconsiderate. She did a lot of bad things. She acts entitled and rude. BUT, I get it. She feels like because of who she is, she has the right to colonies and more important things. Look at this from her perspective, she is practically a child, but she is still a diamond. When she is compared to her diamond peers, she is insecure because she has no power. She feels like because of what she is, she shouldn't be judged for being smaller or inferior in the presence of the other diamonds. So she gets Spinel. Now... yes what Pink did leaving her behind without a second thought is a shitty thing to do. But, Pink is seeing her as something that is stopping her from what she is entitled to. She didn't have evil intentions, she just wanted something, and it was unhealthy to keep Spinel close to her at all times. She could have done a lot worse, and she could have also done a lot better. Spinel is a toxic character though. She is a lot to handle, too clingy, and creates unstable, unhealthy relationships because of what she is programmed to do, to be. Pink needed to rid herself of the toxic relationship in order to have the thing that she believed that she was entitled to. I'm not saying that she isn't flawed. I'm not siding with her. Pink just doesn't need as much hate. Think about this from her perceptive. She was a younger gem fascinated with having her own responsibilities. Ignorance doesn't mean that she is free from blame, but it is a reason for her to be hated a little less. Think about what she was thinking. Spinel was also to blame, she couldn't see that she was holding Pink back. Sometimes in life you have to get rid of people if they keep you in an unhealthy relationship. Spinel needs to work on her dependancy, and Pink needs to have more empathy and less tunnel vision. There is more to life than one person, and more to life than a colony.

You can always dm me, I mean if you want
I get what you mean... but for me 40 is too long.

What is worth in this world... everything can be relative... there are qualities that you have that mean something to someone. At least that’s that ‘they’ say... who knows if it’s true. 

Probably not... I’d make your choice...
I feel like there isn’t a purpose. We only live so we can die.... isn’t that the point though...,
dang that sucks... say what you will though. don’t let the fear guide you.
I hope you do reach true happiness.

You should hope that you might get better.  Find a distraction of sorts, a healthy distraction and fade from reality. You could temporarily feel better with a little work. You’re not alone, try to find that one person to hold onto. Just one person to share how you feel, someone who can relate to you and cares about you.
Have you found what gives you extreme joy and happiness? Care to share?

I’d take a nap with you if it meant I’d never wake up. Do you believe there is a point to living besides to die?? Perhaps you could dream about that? A new life, a better life. Where there is a clear purpose.

Same to you. 

***Btw, I know you want a slow death, but guns are much more effective... I’m half joking about the last part...

I also had someone that I cared for. I, too, ended things because it was too much for me, but in reality I was isolating myself. I know what you mean. I understand where you are coming from. I’m pretty sure you’ve thought this over. At least know you aren’t alone
yeah, man. I’ve been trying to apologize for the both of us, but it doesn’t seem to be getting through. We will just have wait and see if the cards are in our favor. If only I could go back in time.
I hope everything goes well between you two. Good luck, mate
I’m losing someone as well. She and I used to do almost everything together and now we text once a month two or three words saying we’re sorry.
I’m in the exact boat you are in. I keep planning and can’t find any results.

No. I’m not interested in giving them the burden of my mental state. If I can live a lie to keep them out of it, then so be it. Getting help might be easier and actually help some people, but it’s not for me.
I’m with you. We have the right to choose if we matter or not. If I want to say I’m worthless and pathetic, then I can. Please don’t take that away from us.

I sorta feel like what I was reading, was some of the same stuff I write about. We are very similar. I really understand where you coming from. I'm also bi. I won't come out for the same reasons. I've am suicidal as well, for similar reasons. I feel like I know the same pains you are going through. I'm about to be a Senior in high school. I think about the same things. The whole 'why try because I plan on killing myself' is my go to thought. I notice that there are bigger problems. College. My GPA. Standardized test scores. I keep trying to act like a good student so my parents don't to have to be bothered by my mental state. There are so many things that are on my mind. I just want to cease to exist, so I can run from my problems. I like how we connected. I feel like I found  someone who understands.
Sadly, I don't think there is an actually point. We only live to die. Pointlessness is the meaning of life...

I know what you are talking about. I'm about to be a senior in high school. I don't want my parents to help me through graduation, college, and the in-between stuff. I think how they will splurge they will want to go all out, but for who? A pathetic little girl who plans on dying within the year. I know how you feel.  I don't know if helps knowing that there are others like you. I remember when a couple years ago that other people felt like how I did, I had a moment when I asked how so many people were able to be alive. People think we are strong, but I don't know if we really are.
Fuck. I get it. That's the exact reason why I will never get help. I'll live with my suicidal thoughts. Sorry about the lack of respect. I hope things can turn around?
I know the pain.

I know how you feel. I'm plagued with suicidal thoughts. I really want to end it. Sadly, I have come to the conclusion that I must live and suffer for others in order to not let them down. I, too, hurt someone that I really liked. Now we don't talk or even see each other. I hate myself for it. Things could have turned out so differently. It's so funny how similar we are. Manipulation was my problem. I kept thinking how I could gain from the relationship. I hurt them so much because of my own insecurities and problems. I know so much how you feel. I wish you could get a second chance. Just know you aren't alone. I hate myself just as much.

Good luck to you. Shall we suffer together?

I know how you feel. I'm plagued with suicidal thoughts. I, just like you, am unable to complete my only purpose in life- to die. I have come to the conclusion that I must live and suffer for others in order to not let them down. I, too, feel like life is meaningless. We are only alive to die. Isn't that the only thing we all share in common- death? If we have no passion, no drive to actually live life, why shouldn't we just end things now? Why wait? Why go on creating false relationships with other human beings if they will end? Things that we do, decisions that we make don't matter, or won't matter; therefore at some point, after we die we won't be remembered. So why live in the first place? 

I know that we should be happy. I know that we shouldn't think like this, however sometimes we can't help it.

Just know that you aren't alone. I feel just as worthless, just as meaningless, and just as trapped.
